analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 46.1 continues sideways in neutral zone, MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. Volume ratio below 1 for 5 consecutive days indicates subdued buying interest. Limited upside from 5-day low of $520.53 to 5-day high of $559.80. Forming Higher Low pattern with 5-day low ($520.53) matching 20-day low ($520.53). SMA20 at $580.18 and SMA50 at $573.45 act as resistance. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
